diagnosis: The fixed tokenizer does not stem plurals. Four compact descriptions omitted natural owner terms present in the original contracts: URL/refcount disposal, DOM overlay placement, static merge/draw calls, and tween loop/sequence. The SceneStack exclusion target was also incorrect. All 22 candidates are now compact; this is not the earlier mixed-length corpus.
constraints: No question, ownership label, scoring code, threshold, reference, or SKILL body changed. The failed first candidate and raw report remain immutable.

changes.before: Load assets, textures, atlases and BMFont through AssetBank. Use for cache/refcount ownership, runtime pixels or AIR_E_ATLAS_IN_USE and AIR_E_FNT_IN_USE cleanup.
changes.after: Load asset URL textures, atlases and BMFont with AssetBank. Use for refcounted disposal, extension selection, cache reuse or AIR_E_ATLAS_IN_USE/AIR_E_FNT_IN_USE cleanup.

changes.before: Draw Graphics/SVG shapes, rich fills and sprite masks; bind DOM overlays and experimental HTML textures. Use for vector export, gradients, UI blend scopes or AirUIMesh.
changes.after: Draw Graphics/SVG shapes, gradients and sprite masks; align a DOM overlay with UI/canvas nodes. Use for overlay placement, input interception, HTML textures or AirUIMesh.

changes.before: Reduce draws with batching, instancing and dynamic atlases; profile frame budgets. Use for on-demand rendering, AIR_E_MESH_CAPACITY or AIR_E_PIXEL_RATIO_IMPORT_ORDER.
changes.after: Optimize draw calls with static merge, instancing and dynamic atlases. Use for frame budgets, on-demand rendering, AIR_E_MESH_CAPACITY or AIR_E_PIXEL_RATIO_IMPORT_ORDER.

changes.before: Animate with tweens, AnimationClip tracks and a single step clock. Use for looping, reverseTime, playback cleanup, deterministic frames or unavailable pose graphs.
changes.after: Animate tweens and AnimationClip tracks with one step clock. Use to loop a sequence on a target, reverseTime, clean up playback or diagnose unavailable pose graphs.

source.statement: Persistent-page push/pop with preserved state is SceneStack; app.run replacement belongs to application.
